text: ChainGate Wallet（DSH 插件，Web 与 CLI）：在 DSH 中管理多链钱包并查询链上资产。它向 DSH 注册钱包工具，并在 Web 侧边栏加入钱包面板。可创建或导入钱包、派生地址、查看原生币与代币余额、查询交易记录和 UTXO，并估算与准备转账；广播转账需明确确认。适合需要在 DSH 中查看和操作链上钱包的用户。apiKey 为可选配置。

ChainGate Wallet is a DSH plugin for Web and CLI. It registers wallet tools and adds a Web sidebar panel to create or import wallets, derive addresses, check balances, view transactions and UTXOs, and prepare transfers with fee estimates. Broadcast requires confirmation; apiKey is optional.
想在 DSH 里创建或导入一个多链钱包，并查看对应地址。
能不能通过 DSH 查询一个钱包的币种余额和交易记录？
I want to estimate a crypto transfer fee and prepare the transaction before deciding to broadcast it.
ChainGate Wallet 的功能「创建或导入钱包」：通过 DSH 工具生成 HD 钱包，或从私钥、助记词等格式导入，并派生所选网络的地址；可提供密码加密保存。
ChainGate Wallet 的功能「查询资产与准备转账」：通过工具读取网络余额、交易记录等信息，并估算原生币转账费用；未明确确认时只准备交易和费用摘要。
ChainGate Wallet 使用前须知：apiKey 配置可选，配置值会传给 ChainGate SDK；源码未在已读运行文件中固定外部服务域名。

dsh-chaingate-wallet-plugin README · dsh-chaingate-wallet-plugin：> **中文文档**：[README.zh-CN.md](./README.zh-CN.md)

A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) wallet plugin built with the [ChainGate TypeScript SDK](https://github.com/drakensoftware/chaingate).

dsh-chaingate-wallet-plugin README · What it is：`dsh-chaingate-wallet-plugin` exposes multi-chain wallet capabilities to DSH agents: HD wallet creation/import, address derivation, balances (native, ERC-20, NFT), transaction history, UTXO, fee estimation, gas tracking, signing, and broadcasting — via structured tools.

dsh-chaingate-wallet-plugin README · Features：- HD wallet create/import from mnemonic, private key, WIF, xpriv, xpub, keystore.
- Multi-chain networks: BTC, LTC, DOGE, BCH, ETH, AVAX (full API); Polygon, Arbitrum, Base, BNB Chain, Sonic (RPC-only); any EVM chain via custom RPC.
- Balances with confirmed/unconfirmed split and fiat conversion.
- Native, ERC-20, NFT transfer and contract calls with fee estimation.
- Message signing/verification; AES-256-GCM wallet encryption; view-only wallets.
- Broadcast operations require explicit confirmation.
- Built-in DSH web UI: a sidebar **ChainGate 钱包** panel that replaces only the conversation pane. Home shows wallet switching plus BTC/ETH balances in USD/CNY; transfers are AI-assisted — paste the recipient's text or screenshot and AI validates the address/network/amount, prepares fees, and asks for one final confirmation before broadcasting. Advanced tools are collapsed under 高级.

dsh-chaingate-wallet-plugin README · Use cases：- Create or import a wallet and derive addresses.
- Check native/token balances and fiat value.
- Review transaction history and UTXOs.
- Send crypto with recommended fee and explicit confirmation.
- Connect any EVM chain through a custom RPC URL.

See [docs/用例目录/README.md](./docs/用例目录/README.md) for the full SDK use-case catalog (Chinese).

dsh-chaingate-wallet-plugin README · Preconditions：- Node.js 22+, `dsh` CLI installed.
- `npm install chaingate` is bundled as a dependency.

dsh-chaingate-wallet-plugin README · Install from GitHub：```bash
dsh plugin --profile default add github:king-bcolor/dsh-chaingate-wallet-plugin

dsh-chaingate-wallet-plugin README · Install locally：```bash
git clone https://github.com/king-bcolor/dsh-chaingate-wallet-plugin.git
cd dsh-chaingate-wallet-plugin
dsh plugin --profile default add .
```

dsh-chaingate-wallet-plugin README · Usage：Start the web profile and open the printed URL (default `http://127.0.0.1:3080`):

```bash
dsh web
```

In the web UI sidebar, click **ChainGate 钱包** to open the wallet console. For a CLI-only profile:

```bash
dsh --profile default
```
Example prompts:
- `Create a new Bitcoin wallet and show the first address.`
- `Check the ETH balance of address 0x...`
- `Estimate fees and send 0.01 ETH to 0x...` (you will be asked to confirm)

dsh-chaingate-wallet-plugin README · Configuration：```yaml
- id: chaingate-wallet
  name: dsh-chaingate-wallet-plugin
  config:
    apiKey: ""
dsh-chaingate-wallet-plugin README · Security：Never share your mnemonic or private key. The plugin encrypts wallets with AES-256-GCM and never logs secrets.

dsh-chaingate-wallet-plugin README · Development：TDD is mandatory:
```bash
npm install
npm test
npm pack --dry-run
```

dsh-chaingate-wallet-plugin README · dsh-chaingate-wallet-plugin：> **English README**：[README.md](./README.md)

一个使用 [ChainGate TypeScript SDK](https://github.com/drakensoftware/chaingate) 构建的 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 钱包插件。
dsh-chaingate-wallet-plugin README · 它是什么：`dsh-chaingate-wallet-plugin` 把多链钱包能力暴露给 DSH Agent：HD 钱包创建/导入、地址派生、余额（原生币、ERC-20、NFT）、交易历史、UTXO、费用估算、Gas 跟踪、签名与广播，全部通过结构化工具完成。

dsh-chaingate-wallet-plugin README · 功能：- HD 钱包创建/导入：助记词、私钥、WIF、xpriv、xpub、keystore。
- 多链网络：BTC、LTC、DOGE、BCH、ETH、AVAX（全 API）；Polygon、Arbitrum、Base、BNB Chain、Sonic（RPC-only）；任意 EVM 链自定义 RPC。
- 余额查询，支持 confirmed/unconfirmed 拆分与法币换算。
- 原生币、ERC-20、NFT 转账与合约调用，带费用估算。
- 消息签名/验签；AES-256-GCM 钱包加密；view-only 钱包。
- 广播操作默认需要显式确认。
- 内置 DSH Web UI：侧边栏「ChainGate 钱包」面板只替换对话窗口区域。首页只保留钱包切换与 BTC/ETH 资产（自动换算 USD/CNY）；转账走 AI 助手——粘贴对方收款文字或截图，AI 校验地址/网络/金额并试算费用，最后弹窗确认才广播；其余高级功能折叠在「高级」中。

dsh-chaingate-wallet-plugin README · 用例：- 创建或导入钱包并派生地址。
- 查看原生币/代币余额与法币估值。
- 查看交易历史与 UTXO。
- 按推荐费用发送加密货币，广播前确认。
- 通过自定义 RPC 接入任意 EVM 链。

完整 SDK 用例目录见 [docs/用例目录/README.md](./docs/用例目录/README.md)。
